reviews.rationale: Selected GAAP rows show a sequentially stronger quarter across revenue, operating income, attributable net income and diluted EPS, with the profit subtotals moving in the same direction as revenue. The thesis remains active at unchanged conviction pending fuller filing detail and year-over-year context.
